data.animaCaption: Holding out one open palm to catch a drifting cherry petal while wearing a misty-blue striped shirt dress and thin silver glasses, she shoots you an amused sidelong glance. Blurred sakura branches frame the foreground as crisp spring sunlight scatters soft shadows across her dark hair.
data.promptProse: Framed past an overhanging branch of pale cherry blossoms in the foreground, Shiki Natsume pauses along a breezy riverside promenade wearing a misty-blue striped drawstring shirt dress, delicate silver-rimmed glasses, and a woven canvas tote slung over one shoulder. She extends her palm to catch a single pink petal settling in the spring wind, glancing sideways at the viewer with a dry, quietly fond smirk while bright afternoon daylight filters through the blooming canopy.
data.story: 一阵春风吹过河堤，几片樱花刚好落进夏目摊开的掌心。她推了推银色细框眼镜，斜睨着站在原地发呆的你，嘴角勾起一点轻淡的弧度——「只是接住一片花瓣而已，至于盯成这样吗？走了，前面那家甜品店要排队了。」
